summary.ru: Микронезия — обобщающее название групп мелких островов Океании. Состоит из островов Гилберта, Марианских островов, Маршалловых и других.
summary.en: Micronesia is a subregion of Oceania, consisting of approximately 2,000 small islands in the Northwestern Pacific Ocean. It has a close shared cultural history with three other island regions: Maritime Southeast Asia to the west, Polynesia to the east, and Melanesia to the south—as well as with the wider community of Austronesian peoples.
